title: Saudi Arabian Beef Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Saudi Arabia, adapted with Japanese flair. This dish is perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian sausages
ingredients.notes: Use any Japanese-style sausages as a substitute.

instructions: 1. Heat sesame oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add sliced onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add beef stew meat and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
5. Add Saudi Arabian sausages and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
6. Add soy sauce, garlic, and 2 cups of water.
7. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
8. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
9. Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
